description: Find the companies a person or entity is a partner of, by name. Exact (accent-insensitive, case-insensitive) match on the partner name by default; set contains=true for a substring match (uf required). Optionally narrow with cpf_middle (the 6 digits Receita publishes, e.g. '240659') because the same name can belong to different people. Returns company name, status and role.
name: search_partners
